title: Photo↔route first-pass data-quality audit

codex.command: codex exec --model gpt-6-astra ... ; resumed via: codex exec resume -m gpt-6-astra --skip-git-repo-check --output-schema dq-001-codex-schema.json -o dq-001-astra-raw.json 01a0bd7b-87ab-7231-be23-33618a3da79e

schema_suggestion: Add optional routeAnnotations[] to PhotoEntry with routeId nullable, sourceName, sourceLabel, printedGrade, gradeSystem nullable, sourceUrl, page, status and note. Resolve routeId only to existing records using crag plus sector and source context; retain unresolved labels without creating routes. Preserve printed grades independently of DB grades, including unknown historical grade systems. Add optional cragIds[] for genuinely shared images and update membership accordingly; these four dual-labeled images instead support individual canonical crag labels. Keep landmark annotations distinct from route annotations. Do not invent image coordinates or equate topo numbers across different faces.
notes: Analysis only; no files edited or external sources checked. Rankings follow the requested priorities rather than raw scan scores. Route IDs and photo-manifest paths were not supplied. Batch notes contain JSON-encoded lists of proposed record-relative patches; select records by the stated file or route selector before applying. New annotation fields require schema support first. Unverified flags cover unresolved identity, attribution, or grade judgments, not merely whether a discrepancy exists. Scan corrections: Charly's Crack is 6a in both the full caption and DB; the reported caption grade 5 is a bolt-count extraction error. Shady Crack B 6c matches DB B in Shady Crack, not Route B 6a in Low Bulge. Sai Daeng's full caption explicitly says no route names, contradicting the scan's Route A candidate. Community action captions describe single routes; duplicated fuzzy candidates do not establish multiple routes or spelling drift. Forewarned has an additional caption-versus-DB conflict, 6a versus 5c, deferred below the top ten. No individual community Backyard/Frontyard alias or scenic_non_crag records were supplied, so concrete edits for those categories are unsupported. Do not infer aliases from URL slugs alone. The unlocated p44 action photo should retain null crag; it is not evidence of scenic_non_crag.

top10.issue: Dual label prevents canonical membership; scan resolves the Lang Khai topo to Aow Luek. Multiple routes lack structured links, with additional grade conflicts.
top10.evidence: Caption title is 'Lang Khaai Bay'; the Lang Khai subset contains Planet Paradise, Tantalis and the other named problems. Flags include dual_crag_label and no_routeId_multi_route_gap. Caption reports Tantalis V6, Hairy Classic Right V2 and Zenalithic V2; DB reports 7B, 6B and 6B+, respectively, with verified=false. The stated exact-name or 'Name (' membership rule does not accept the slash label for either crag.
top10.proposed_fix: Replace photo.crag with Lang Khai. Add annotations tied to existing Lang Khai records after ID lookup. Preserve printed grades and mark cross-source grade reconciliation unresolved; do not overwrite grades from scan comparisons.

top10.issue: Dual label obscures Sai Tong membership and produces a misleading Peak Boulders scan resolution.
top10.evidence: Caption title is 'Sai Tong area'. Return of the Jeddi and Hels's arete occur in the supplied Sai Tong subset, while the scan resolved_slug is the-peak-boulders. Caption explicitly marks exact placement inferred and unverified.
top10.proposed_fix: Replace photo.crag with Sai Tong while retaining the placement uncertainty. Annotate the two existing named routes after ID lookup; preserve H and M as printed labels without converting them.

top10.issue: Dual label breaks membership for a specifically titled Peak Boulders topo with seven named routes.
top10.evidence: Caption title is 'The Peak Boulders'. All seven scan-matched names occur in the supplied The Peak Boulders subset. Flags include dual_crag_label and no_routeId_multi_route_gap. Caption's '9 known crags' wording conflicts with the package inventory of 29 crags.
top10.proposed_fix: Replace photo.crag with The Peak Boulders. Remove obsolete inventory-based uncertainty wording only after preserving any actual location uncertainty. Add annotations for the seven existing named records; leave anonymous markers unresolved.

top10.issue: Dual label breaks membership despite direct Aow Luek evidence; caption also falsely describes its crag field as null.
top10.evidence: Caption title is 'Aow Luek' and ends 'so crag is null', while photo.crag is Aow Luek / Lang Khai. The supplied Aow Luek subset includes all eight named matches and existing numbered placeholders #2, #8 and #10.
top10.proposed_fix: Replace photo.crag with Aow Luek and remove the stale final sentence about nine crags and null attribution. Link named and numbered entries only to the supplied existing records after ID lookup.

top10.issue: Confirmed Mosquito/Mosquit spelling drift and Devine Intervention grade disagreement complicate eight-route linking.
top10.evidence: Full caption says 'Mosquito Burrito 6a' and 'Devine Intervention 6a+'. DB has Mosquit Burrito 6a and Devine Intervention 5c in De-Vine Wall. The scan truncates Devine's caption grade to 6a, so its conflict text is not exact. DB source URLs themselves use mosquit-burrito and devine-intervention.
top10.proposed_fix: Preserve Mosquito Burrito as the source-name variant attached to the existing Mosquit Burrito record; canonical renaming needs source review. Annotate Devine Intervention with printedGrade 6a+ and an unresolved conflict against DB 5c. Resolve all links by De-Vine Wall context.

top10.issue: Confirmed bitch/Btich spelling drift and a grade conflict accompany a multi-route topo, including an unlabeled line.
top10.evidence: Caption says 'Son of a bitch 7a' versus DB 'Son of A Btich' 7a, and 'The bitch in me 6c' versus DB 6b+. DB includes an existing '(unlabeled line)' 6c+ in Quit Your'e Bitchin', matching the caption's unlabeled 6c+ line.
top10.proposed_fix: Record Son of a bitch as the printed variant for the existing Son of A Btich record, pending canonical spelling review. Preserve The bitch in me printedGrade 6c with unresolved DB conflict. Match the unlabeled line using sector and source context, without creating or naming a new route.

top10.issue: Single-route action caption reports a different grade from the scan's DB value.
top10.evidence: Caption: 'Rachel Fagan climbing Do It! (6c+) at Golden View.' Scan reports Do It! DB grade 6b. Supplied photo sourceUrl is https://rakkup.com/koh-tao-thailand-rock-climbing-by-kelsey-gray/. No Golden View route subset was provided.
top10.proposed_fix: Add one unresolved annotation for Do It!, preserving caption grade 6c+ and documenting scan-reported DB grade 6b. Review the existing route and cited source before choosing a grade. Discard the scanner's person-prefixed duplicate candidate.

top10.issue: Map names lack reliable route links; scanner conflates landmarks with routes and reports unmatched names and a grade conflict.
top10.evidence: Caption lists The Lost Idol V8, Jungle Science V9, Mantle V6 and Predator V7 as problems, but Big Brother as a landmark. Scan reports the last three problem names unmatched, The Lost Idol DB grade 8B, and Big Brother and Tao as matched routes. No corresponding route subset is supplied.
top10.proposed_fix: Keep Backyard & Frontyard as the supplied canonical crag. Annotate the four explicit problem names as unresolved pending existing-record lookup; preserve The Lost Idol's printed V8 separately. Exclude Big Brother and incidental place-name text from automatic route linking. Do not create the unmatched routes.

top10.issue: Related maps disagree on a printed name and marker interpretation; scanner cannot establish missing routes or grade errors reliably.
top10.evidence: p29 caption has 'Under Frondly Fire V4'; p34-0-X112 caption has 'Under Friendly Fire V4'. Both scans mark the respective name unmatched. p29 calls VE/E/M/MH/H/VH difficulty codes, whereas p34 speculates they are quality/star markers. Scan reports James and the Giant Peach V11 versus DB 8A+ and Pancake Ninja V6/VH versus DB 7A, without a supplied Secret Garden route subset.
top10.proposed_fix: Retain both name transcriptions as unresolved pending image/source review; do not silently normalize or create a route. Record raw grade tokens without deciding what the letter codes mean. Keep map landmarks separate from route candidates and defer cross-system grade judgments.

top10.issue: The Trunk is falsely flagged absent because DB inverts the article; topo numbering also presents an identity ambiguity.
top10.evidence: Caption lists '9. The Wet Beaver 4' and '11. The Trunk 7a'. Supplied DB includes The Wet Beaver 4 and Trunk, The 7a, whose sourceUrl ends /the-trunk. DB also includes '(The Elephant #11)' VE, so matching only number 11 would select a conflicting record.
top10.proposed_fix: Match printed The Trunk to existing Trunk, The using crag, name variant, grade and source context. Preserve source label 11 without equating it to the numbered placeholder. Link The Wet Beaver independently; leave unidentified lines unresolved.
